newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Storm grounds PIA airbus in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Storm grounds PIA airbus in Karachi.

text.p: A wind storm damaged a parked A-310 Airbus of the state-run Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) at Karachi airport, grounding it for at least a fortnight, a PIA spokesman said on Tuesday.
He said the storm, which lashed Karachi overnight, dislodged a walkway that hit the right wing of the plane. "At least 15 days are needed for the repair of the plane," the spokesman said.
He did not give the extent of the damage, but said the plane was insured.
